# testdata

Generated input for the Rust test suite. Not examples, not a demo, and not
offered to users anywhere in the app.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `synthetic-log.txt` | Proxifier log covering every line shape the parser handles, plus traffic that trips a good share of the detection catalog. Regenerate with `python tools/gen-sample-log.py`. |

Every host, address and process in here is invented: hostnames use `.example`
and `.invalid`, addresses come from the RFC 5737 and RFC 3849 documentation
ranges. Nothing in this directory may be derived from a real capture — that
is the whole reason it is generated by a script rather than trimmed from a
log someone had lying around.
